title: feat(state): state records are searchable and delivered by subject
context:
The five nuryel.state/1 kinds (receipts, commitments, derived, entities,
relationships) were stored and counted but neither indexed nor delivered.
Reindex now writes every state record into the search index under its own
kind, same FTS shape, no schema bump: title = the subject key, body = the
summary/title + actor/owner + status label + dates. History stays indexed
and ranks below the state of record (superseded, done, cancelled, failed,
retired records are demoted on every search path, never d Touches invariant(s): con_902759b3dc (All JSON writes to .hunch/ must be atomic (temp-file + rename) so an interrupted write can never truncate the index); con_a87360128b (Semantic vectors are a derived layer in SQLite, never the source of truth; reconcile by content hash on reindex); con_e04226bd05 (The MCP server must stay client-agnostic: all assistants point to the same .hunch/ graph; no Claude-only behavior in the server).
decision: Introduced src/cli, src/core, src/mcp, src/store, test/state-kinds-search.test.ts: added formatSearchHit, StateKind, isStateKind, StateRecord, StateLiveness, stateLiveness, stateSubject, stateObservedAt; new dep(s): node:test, node:assert/strict, node:fs, node:os, node:path, @modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/index.js; 2 new file(s).
consequences: Adds dependency: node:test, node:assert/strict, node:fs, node:os, node:path, @modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/index.js, @modelcontextprotocol/sdk/inMemory.js.
